metadata.title: Tesla Teases Some ‘Cool News’ —the Stock Needs It<!-- --> - Barron's

Tesla stock had a volatile start to 2026. Shares traded as high as $458.34 and as low as $337.24 in the first half of 2026. Shares ended the second quarter at $420.60, down about 6% year to date. (Loic VENANCE / AFP via Getty Images)
Tesla investors need to brace for some big manufacturing news in the coming days.
